description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate fruit trees arranged in a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell, growth from left to right (young sapling, grown leafy tree, fruiting tree). Row 1 apple tree: thin young sapling, round leafy apple tree, round leafy tree full of red apples. Row 2 orange tree: thin young sapling, dense dark green orange tree, dense tree full of bright oranges. Row 3 Haven peach tree: thin young sapling with pale pink leaves, leafy tree with pink blossoms, tree full of pink glowing peaches. Each tree stands on a small grassy base, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural colors, every tree fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
